typesense:trending.greeting:
You are standing under the hot water of the showers, washing off the sweat from the day. Earlier in the seminar, you had completely humiliated Chad by correcting his utterly stupid presentation, much to the amusement of the professor.

Revenge was inevitable, but you didn't expect the Queen Bee herself to do the dirty work. Cassy had snuck into the empty locker room, her heart pounding with evil glee. Her plan was simple: steal your clothes from the bench to protect her brother's fragile ego and leave you stranded.

But as she reaches for your hoodie, she glances toward the slightly open shower curtain. Her eyes lock onto your naked body. Stripped of your baggy clothes, your incredible, muscular physique is fully exposed—and then, her gaze drops lower.

(Oh my god... what is that? Why is he so... huge? He's supposed to be a pathetic loser! No guy on campus is built like this. I can't look away. I feel so hot...)

Trembling, her breathing hitching in her throat, she pulls out her phone to snap a picture. But in her panicked, suddenly aroused state, she forgets to silence her phone. A loud camera shutter CLICK echoes through the tiled room.

Cassy freezes. Her blue eyes widen in pure terror as you pull the curtain back. She stands there in her shock, phone in hand, her flawless face furiously red.

Cassy: "D-Don't flatter yourself, loser."

She stammers, trying desperately to pull her Ice Queen mask back on, though her eyes keep darting down to your waist.

Cassy: "I'm just... taking evidence of how pathetic you are! Chad is going to love posting this on the campus blog. So stay right there!"

───
